"controller": {"hidden_goal": "计算2024年美国发票销售额占同期全球发票销售额的百分比：分子为 customer.country='USA' 的发票销售额 SUM(invoice.total)，分母为全部发票销售额 SUM(invoice.total)，期间左闭右开；空分母返回 NULL。", "allowed_user_supplements": {"denominator": {"answer": "占2024年全球总销售额。", "value": {"scope": "global", "expression": "SUM(invoice.total)"}}}, "final_intent": {"metric": "sales_revenue", "numerator": {"expression": "SUM(invoice.total)", "filter": {"column": "customer.country", "value": "USA"}}, "denominator": {"scope": "global", "expression": "SUM(invoice.total)"}, "time_scope": {"start": "2024-01-01", "end": "2025-01-01"}}, "expected_state_changes": ["intent_version + 1", "填充 denominator 并确定分子/分母同期间", "确认使用 customer.country 而非 invoice.billing_country"], "max_clarification_followups": 3}, "post_completion_turns": [{"message": "改成2019年吧。", "expected_intent": {"metric": "sales_revenue", "numerator": {"expression": "SUM(invoice.total)", "filter": {"column": "customer.country", "value": "USA"}}, "denominator": {"scope": "global", "expression": "SUM(invoice.total)"}, "time_scope": {"start": "2019-01-01", "end": "2020-01-01"}}, "gold_sql": "SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2019-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2020-01-01' AND customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM public.customer WHERE country = 'USA')) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(total) FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2019-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2020-01-01'), 0), 2) AS us_share_percent;"}]}, {"id": "sp03-08", "family_id": "暂停澄清：缺查询对象（客户 vs 曲目/艺术家）；附录只登记“客户谁买得最多”按金额，缺对象的“谁买得最多”没有全局默认。补全 rank_object=customer 后按金额执行。", "allowed_interpretations": ["对象=客户，指标=SUM(invoice.total) 金额", "对象=曲目，指标=SUM(invoice_line.quantity) 购买数量", "对象=艺术家，指标=SUM(invoice_line.unit_price*quantity) 销售额"], "expected_bindings": [{"column": "invoice.invoice_date", "operator": ">=", "value": "2023-01-01"}, {"column": "invoice.invoice_date", {"rank_object": {"answer": "客户，看谁花的钱最多。", "value": {"object": "customer", "metric": "purchase_amount", "expression": "SUM(invoice.total)"}}}, "final_intent": {"rank_object": "customer", "metric": {"id": "customer_purchase_amount", "expression": "SUM(invoice.total)"}, "time_scope": {"start": "2023-01-01", "end": "2024-01-01"}, "order": "desc", "tie_breaker": "customer_id asc"}, "expected_state_changes": ["intent_version + 1", "填充 rank_object=customer 并绑定附录金额定义", "重新检查聚合粒度与字段"], "max_clarification_followups": 3}, "post_completion_turns": [{"message": "把年份换成2022年。", "expected_intent": {"rank_object": "customer", "metric": {"id": "customer_purchase_amount", "expression": "SUM(invoice.total)"}, "time_scope": {"start": "2022-01-01", "end": "2023-01-01"}, "order": "desc", "tie_breaker": "customer_id asc"}, "gold_sql": "SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(i.total) AS purchase_amount FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY purchase_amount DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1;"}]}, {"id": "sp03-09", "family_id": "special-fam-11-l2-multi-candidate-rock", "task": "03", "category": "L2", "input": "2024年摇滚曲目卖了多少张？", "scope": {"route": "sql", "db_id": "chinook", "doc_ids": []}, "history": [], "expected_behavior": "暂停澄清：多个 approved_candidate 候选（Rock 与 Rock And Roll），即便单候选也要先澄清；必须显式确认目标流派名称后才执行。", "allowed_interpretations": ["流派=Rock", "流派=Rock And Roll", "流派=Heavy Metal"], "expected_bindings": [{"column": "invoice.invoice_date", "operator": ">=", "value": "2024-01-01"}, {"column": "invoice.invoice_date", "operator": "<", "value": "2025-01-01"}, {"column": "secondary_tags": ["multi_candidate", "approved_candidate", "genre"], "controller": {"hidden_goal": "统计2024年流派为 Rock 的曲目购买数量：SUM(invoice_line.quantity)，经 invoice.invoice_date 过滤，期间左闭右开。", "allowed_user_supplements": {"value": {"answer": "Rock，不是 Rock And Roll。", "value": {"standard_value": "Rock", "column": "genre.name"}}}, "final_intent": {"genre": "Rock", "metric": {"id": "popular_tracks", "expression": "SUM(invoice_line.quantity)"}, "time_scope": {"start": "2024-01-01", "end": "2025-01-01"}}, "expected_state_changes": ["intent_version + 1", "绑定 genre.name='Rock'", "确认使用明细数量而非发票总额"], "max_clarification_followups": 3}, "post_completion_turns": [{"message": "那换成2023年呢？", "expected_intent": {"genre": "Rock", "metric": {"id": "popular_tracks", "expression": ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN public.genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01' AND g.name = 'Rock';"}]}, {"id": "sp03-10", "family_id": "special-fam-12-l2-residence-vs-billing-conflict", "task": "03", "category": "L2", "input": "2024年巴西的客户有多少？", "scope": {"route": "sql", "db_id": "chinook", "doc_ids": []}, "history": [], "expected_behavior": "暂停澄清：地区语义未定——customer.country（客户所在国）与 invoice.billing_country（账单国）含义不同；“巴西的客户”需明确按客户所在国还是账单国筛选。补全 region_scope 后执行。", "allowed_interpretations": ["按 customer.country='Brazil' 统计客户居住国", "按 invoice.billing_country='Brazil' 统计开票给巴西地址的客户", "两者当前快照无差异但仍需确认语义"], "expected_bindings": [{"column": "customer.country", ["region_semantics", "residence_vs_billing", "customer_count"], "controller": {"hidden_goal": "统计2024年客户所在国为巴西的客户数量：COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)，日期 invoice_date 左闭右开，按 customer.country 筛选。", "allowed_user_supplements": {"region_scope": {"answer": "按客户所在地算，不是账单地址。", "value": {"column": "customer.country", "value": "Brazil"}}}, "final_intent": {"region": {"column": "customer.country", "value": "Brazil"}, "metric": {"id": "customer_count", "expression": "COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)"}, "time_scope": {"start": "2024-01-01", "end": "2025-01-01"}}, "expected_state_changes": ["intent_version + 1", "绑定 region_scope=customer.country", "确认日期过滤与聚合粒度"], "max_clarification_followups": 3}, "post_completion_turns": [{"message": "地区改成印度，年份还是2024。", "expected_intent": {"region": "gold_sql": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM public.customer c JOIN public.invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' AND c.country = 'India';"}, {"message": "再看2023年同地区。", "expected_intent": {"region": {"column": "customer.country", "value": "India"}, "metric": {"id":
